articles.title: The Ondo Finance succession crisis gets messier as Kathleen Allman’s daughter alleges ‘dementia’, alcoholism and reckless spending
articles.description: The estranged daughter of 77-year-old Kathleen Allman has petitioned a Hawaiian court to establish a limited conservatorship to protect her parents’ share of her brother’s stake in Ondo.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
articles.description: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

articles.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
articles.description: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.

articles.title: Is the AI safety debate about safety or control?
articles.description: Not everyone agrees with Amodei's call for globally coordinated action for AI safety.

articles.title: UN turns to Google to make its global data ready for AI agents
articles.description: The shift comes after a UNICEF test found leading AI models struggled to accurately retrieve global development statistics.

articles.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
articles.description: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.description: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: Kevin O’Leary says Congress will revisit Clarity early next year as crypto tax bill advances
articles.description: The Shark Tank investor says Congress will face pressure to revive crypto market structure legislation as it moves to establish tax rules for digital assets.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.description: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.description: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.

articles.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
articles.description: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.

articles.title: Base Labs launches an open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
articles.description: Base Labs, the research group Baseten spun up earlier this year, will develop and publish methods for training and monitoring open models.

articles.title: Pinterest teases a new ‘Restyle’ feature that lets you redesign your room with AI
articles.description: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.

articles.title: Is there any chance left to save the CLARITY Act?
articles.description: CLARITY isn’t dead after failing a key Senate vote, but with time running short and Democrats still demanding changes, its path forward is narrowing.

articles.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Events schedule: NMI, Backblaze, PeakXV Partners, Augment, and more to host
articles.description: TechCrunch Disrupt is where the tech community comes together to build, debate, and connect. And while the main event takes over Moscone West from October 13-15, the conversation doesn’t stop when the Expo Hall closes.

articles.title: Bitcoin coils near $76.5K as US stocks rebound from Fed rate hike
articles.description: Bitcoin made modest daily gains as US stocks saw upside in the aftermath of the US Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since July 2023.

articles.title: Apple will let EU apps use less-alarming tracking-consent screens
articles.description: Apple is changing its App Tracking Transparency prompts in parts of Europe after competition regulators said the system favored Apple over third-party apps, giving developers more flexibility over how they ask users for tracking consent.

articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude taps former Hut 8 CEO to lead ahead of public listing
articles.description: Former Hut 8 CEO Jaime Leverton will take the helm at Fortitude as the Zcash-focused miner expands its operations and moves toward a planned public listing.

articles.title: UK signals end of 'light-touch' era with multi-agency raid on peer-to-peer crypto hubs
articles.description: Increased enforcement coincides with detailed regulatory guidance issued to crypto firms ahead of the full framework taking effect in late 2027.
